title: About Us: AI Product Photos and Video Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: AIVideosUGC turns one product photo into store images and short video ads for a small shop, with no studio, no casting, and private uploads. See how it works.
h1: About AIVideosUGC: Product Visuals Made Simple
lead: AIVideosUGC helps a small shop make product photos and short video ads from one product photo, so you can review a file in your account instead of booking a shoot.
secondary_keywords: product content tool for Etsy shops

sections.h2: Store images and short video ads
paras: Upload a picture of what you sell, pick a template or describe the scene, and download a square store image or a short video of 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
The weekly jobs are a clean listing shot, AI lifestyle product photos, AI model photos for clothing, a feed image, and a vertical clip. No design software, no agency booking, and no studio day.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a blonde chin-length bob sets a plain ceramic mug on paper beside a closed laptop.

sections.h2: AI visuals for Shopify sellers and small shops
paras: It is built for small and growing stores on Shopify, Amazon, and Etsy, and for the marketers who run their ads. If you pack orders, write listings, and set campaigns yourself, this fits the week you already have.

You do not need editing skills. A clear product photo and one sentence about the scene are enough to start. It is a product content tool for Etsy shops when a hook or an offer changes and you need a new image or clip. Shopify product photos are one of the listing jobs it covers.
sections.alt: Adult small-shop owner prepares a plain product for a listing at a packing table.

sections.h2: A private AI product photo tool
paras: Everything you upload and everything you make stays in your own account. Your product photos and results are not shown to other customers or published.
Some requests are turned down, including celebrities or other public figures, and logos or trademarks that belong to someone else. The ad stays on products you sell.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a copper-red low bun sits by a closed laptop and a small brass padlock.

sections.h2: Credit costs on screen before you start
paras: Every photo and video shows its price in credits before the job starts, so nothing spends without your say-so. Plans start at $24.50 a month with 200 credits.

Credits are held while a job runs and used when the file arrives. A delivered file is not refunded, which is why the cost is on screen first. If a job fails, the credits return to your balance automatically.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a short silver crop reviews plain wooden tokens beside a closed laptop.

faq.q: Can I make product ads without hiring an agency?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your product photo or describe the scene, review the result, and download it from your account. There is no booking, no shoot day, and no editor to wait on.

faq.q: How do I reach the team?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com. Email is how you reach the team.
Upload a product photo for an image. For a video, upload a photo or describe the product and the scene. Compare the result with the real item before you download or publish it.
Online sellers and marketers who need product photos and short ad videos from their own product images or descriptions, without a studio or an agency.
Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits, and each photo or video shows its credit cost before the job starts. If a job fails, its credits come back automatically.

faq.q: Do you keep a presenter I can reuse?
faq.a: No. Your uploads and results stay in your account, and each new asset starts from the product reference you provide. There is no saved presenter library.
